code='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # Find full-length uniform separator lines, excluding background.
    hr=[i for i,row in enumerate(g) if len(set(row))==1 and row[0]!=bg]
    vc=[j for j in range(len(g[0])) if len({row[j] for row in g})==1 and g[0][j]!=bg]
    rb=[-1]+hr+[len(g)]; cb=[-1]+vc+[len(g[0])]
    tiles=[]
    for ri,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(rb[:-1],rb[1:])):
        for ci,(c,d) in enumerate(zip(cb[:-1],cb[1:])):
            t=[row[c+1:d] for row in g[a+1:b]]
            if any(x!=bg for row in t for x in row): tiles.append((ri,ci,t))
    # Copy the unique marked tile to all tile positions.
    src=tiles[0][2]
    for ri,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(rb[:-1],rb[1:])):
        for ci,(c,d) in enumerate(zip(cb[:-1],cb[1:])):
            for x in range(a+1,b):
                for y in range(c+1,d): g[x][y]=src[x-a-1][y-c-1]
    return g
'''
